products.name: Nudie Jeans Lean Dean Dry 16 Dips Mid Waist Slim Tapered Fit Men's Organic Jeans W29/L32 Sustainable Denim
products.description: Jeans made in comfort stretch denim. Like the name implies, this dry, deep blue, option has been through 16 indigo dips. Unlike other stretch denim, these are not rinsed, so they are stiffer, and will shrink a bit more. Account for inseam shrinkage of 2% and 4.5-6% in width. Thus, sizing down is not recommended.

products.name: Nudie Jeans Easy Alvin Olive Men's Organic Khakis W32/L34 Sustainable Clothing
products.description: Slim fit four-pocket chino made in a clean organic comfort stretch twill. It is a contemporary classic with slanted front pockets, welt back pockets, chain stitch hems, and slim tapered fit. If you ask us, it is the perfect slim fit chino - fitted with a bit of room around the legs, making it look neat and fit very comfortably. Its sewn with heavy tone-in-tone thread with medium-short stitch length, which emphasizes its clean construction and pays homage to its workwear heritage.

Wenn du eine pechschwarze Jeans suchst, die nicht ausbleicht, hast du hier das richtige Modell gefunden. Willst du wissen, was Everblack von anderem schwarzen Denim unterscheidet? Normalerweise wird beim Färben von Denim nur ein Teil des Farbstoffs von den Baumwollfasern absorbiert, währen
